Play it smart and build long-term wealth, or take risky paths that can change everything fast. Every decision brings rewards, setbacks, and consequences that shape your story.

No two lives feel the same. Every year brings new choices, new opportunities, and new outcomes.

Create your character. Make your choices. Build your future.

Made by a solo developer, and shaped by player feedback.
